resolution.excerpt:
23 type Zone struct {
   24 	Type   ZoneType `json:"type"`
   25 	Cards  []*Card  `json:"cards"`
   26 	Owner  int      `json:"owner"` // Player index who owns this zone
   27 
   28 	// game back-references the owning GameState so Graveyard zones can stamp
   29 	// TurnEnteredGraveyardAnyZone at AddCard/AddCardToBottom time without
   30 	// every one of the ~90 existing call sites needing to be rewritten to
   31 	// pass a turn count explicitly ([VOCAB] #1202). Wired once, right after
   32 	// construction, by NewGameWithFormat (see gamestate.go); left nil in
   33 	// hand-built test Zones (e.g. NewZone used directly in a test), which is
   34 	// harmless — stampGraveyardEntry below no-ops when it's nil. Unexported
   35 	// and therefore skipped by encoding/json, so this does not create a
   36 	// marshal cycle with GameState's own JSON tags.
   37 	game *GameState
   38 }

1360 type Player struct {
 1361 	Index       int      `json:"index"` // Player number (0 or 1)
 1362 	Name        string   `json:"name"`

 1364 	ManaPool    ManaPool `json:"mana_pool"`
 1365 	HasPriority bool     `json:"has_priority"` // Rule 117 - Timing and Priority
 1366 
 1367 	// StartingLife records the life total this player began the game with
 1368 	// (Rule 119.1) — fixed at NewPlayer and never touched again, so "as long
 1369 	// as your life total is [more/less] than [half/N more than] your
 1370 	// starting life total" conditions (Anya Merciless Angel, Elenda Saint of
 1371 	// Dusk, Myrkul Lord of Bones, Righteous Valkyrie kin) can compare Life
 1372 	// against a stable baseline instead of the game's default StartingLife
 1373 	// (wrong for Commander's 40 vs Constructed's 20).
 1374 	StartingLife int `json:"starting_life"`
 1375 
 1376 	// Zones (Rule 400)
 1377 	Library   *Zone `json:"library"`
 1378 	Hand      *Zone `json:"hand"`
 1379 	Graveyard *Zone `json:"graveyard"`
 1380 	Exile     *Zone `json:"exile"`
 1381 	Command   *Zone `json:"command"` // Rule 408 - command zone (Commander)
 1382 	// CommanderDamage tracks combat damage taken from each commander (by card
 1383 	// ID) this game; 21 from one commander loses (Rule 704.5v).
 1384 	CommanderDamage map[string]int `json:"commander_damage,omitempty"`
 1385 
 1386 	// Game state tracking
 1387 	LandsPlayedThisTurn int             `json:"lands_played_this_turn"` // Rule 305.1 - Can play one land per turn
 1388 	HasPassedPriority   bool            `json:"has_passed_priority"`
 1389 	HasDrawnThisTurn    bool            `json:"has_drawn_this_turn"` // For miracle tracking
 1390 	DeckID              string          `json:"deck_id"`             // Reference to deck used
 1391 	AutoPassUntil       AutoPassSetting `json:"auto_pass_until"`     // Auto-pass until specified phase
 1392 
 1393 	// Rule 106.11 — Energy is a player-scoped non-mana resource. Unlike
 1394 	// mana it persists across phases/turns and is only ever spent by an
 1395 	// effect that explicitly pays "{E}".
 1396 	EnergyCounters int `json:"energy"`
 1397 
 1398 	// Experience counters (Rule 122.1a) — player-scoped, only ever
 1399 	// accumulate ("you get an experience counter"); commander-2015-style
 1400 	// effects scale off the total.
 1401 	ExperienceCounters int `json:"experience,omitempty"`
 1402 
 1403 	// RingTemptedCount — LOTR "the Ring tempts you" mechanic ([VOCAB] #1261,
 1404 	// Frodo, Sauron's Bane class: "if the Ring has tempted you four or more
 1405 	// times this game..."). Game-lifetime persistent, mirrors
 1406 	// ExperienceCounters immediately above (only ever accumulates, never
 1407 	// reset by NextTurn — the condition explicitly reads "this game", not
 1408 	// "this turn"). Incremented by GameState.RingTemptsPlayer, which also
 1409 	// publishes EventRingTempts for "whenever the Ring tempts you" triggers
 1410 	// (Gandalf, Friend of the Shire and others currently document this as a
 1411 	// MISSING_PRIMITIVE gap).
 1412 	RingTemptedCount int `json:"ring_tempted_count,omitempty"`
 1413 
 1414 	// LifeGainedThisTurn counts every life-gain event this player has had
 1415 	// since the start of the current turn. Reset by NextTurn. Drives
 1416 	// "if you gained life this turn" triggers (e.g. Ocelot Pride).
 1417 	LifeGainedThisTurn int `json:"life_gained_this_turn"`
 1418 
 1419 	// LifeLostThisTurn counts every point of life this player has lost since
 1420 	// the start of the current turn (damage AND pure life loss — TakeDamage
 1421 	// funnels through LoseLife). Reset by NextTurn. Drives "if an opponent
 1422 	// lost life this turn" gates (e.g. Rakdos, Lord of Riots).
 1423 	LifeLostThisTurn int `json:"life_lost_this_turn,omitempty"`
 1424 
 1425 	// DamageTakenThisTurn counts every point of damage (combat AND
 1426 	// noncombat) this player has actually been dealt since the start of the
 1427 	// current turn, INCLUDING Infect damage that becomes poison counters
 1428 	// instead of life loss (Infect still deals damage per Rule 120; it just
 1429 	// redirects the result). Reset by NextTurn. Unlike LifeLostThisTurn —
 1430 	// which also picks up pure life-loss effects with no damage event at all
 1431 	// (paying life for a cost, "each player loses N life") — this is
 1432 	// damage-only, incremented at the two damage-to-player chokepoints:
 1433 	// applyCombatDamageToPlayer (combat.go) and the player branch of
 1434 	// DamageTargetFromSource (targeting.go). Drives numeric "X = damage
 1435 	// dealt to opponents this turn" Bloodthirst-variant effects via
 1436 	// cardfns.DamageDealtToOpponentsThisTurn (VOCAB #1056).
 1437 	DamageTakenThisTurn int `json:"damage_taken_this_turn,omitempty"`
 1438 
 1439 	// PermanentsSacrificedThisTurn counts every permanent this player has
 1440 	// sacrificed since the start of the current turn (Rule 701.17). Reset
 1441 	// by NextTurn; bumped at the single EventSacrifice publication point
 1442 	// (actions.go Sacrifice). Drives "where X is the number of permanents
 1443 	// you've sacrificed this turn" (A-Pyre-Sledge Arsonist class) via the
 1444 	// "permanents_sacrificed_this_turn" count spec.
 1445 	PermanentsSacrificedThisTurn int `json:"permanents_sacrificed_this_turn,omitempty"`
 1446

 1449 	// N or more cards this turn" gates (e.g. Gwaihir the Windlord's cast-cost
 1450 	// reduction), via game.CostReductionFns.
 1451 	CardsDrawnThisTurn int `json:"cards_drawn_this_turn,omitempty"`
 1452

resolution.doc:
regEffect registers a primitive from a per-round file. NEW ROUNDS MUST use
a dedicated backend/cards/registry_<topic>.go with
	func init() { regEffect("verb", Primitive{...}) }
instead of appending to the V2EffectRegistry literal above — tail-appends to
the literal are a recurring merge-conflict class (5 conflicts in one night,
2026-08-02, incl. brace-truncations and duplicated fields from marker-union
resolution). The literal is FROZEN; init() files never conflict.
Panics on duplicate so a bad merge fails the build instead of silently
shadowing an entry. (Package-level var init runs before any init(), so the
literal is always populated first.)
resolution.name: regEffect
